title: Pneumonia, home; disposition, pending results, goals of care and plan discussion written in clinical shorthand

rationale.disposition: 'Dispo: home w/ wife, no services needed' states the disposition in standard shorthand.
rationale.pending_results: 'Outstanding at d/c' lists blood cultures (no growth at 48h, final pending) and names PCP Dr. Lindqvist to follow them up, which is what the rule asks for.
rationale.goals_of_care: 'Resus status: full resuscitation' is the code status, and the patient's stated goal and advance directive preference are recorded.
rationale.dp_discussed: 'Plan reviewed w/ pt + wife at bedside; both agreeable' and the nursing teach-back show the plan was discussed with the patient and his wife.
rationale.pac_list: Home without services, so the post-acute rules do not apply.
